# Feature request: New training module

Add a new training module to the [OLS training portfolio](https://we-are-ols.org/training/training-catalogue).
---
# Required training module info

**Training module video link:** HTML link to the training video with the start time in it. E.g. https://youtu.be/videostring?t=268

**Module title:** E.g. "FAIR Data practices"

**Description of training module:** One to two sentences, to be displayed on the OLS training catalogue page.

**Date training module was recorded:** YYYY-MM-DD

**Topic:** Which training topic does this training module fit under?

Existing training topics are:
 - Open Science
 - Open Data

If this is a new topic, please fill out the new training topic information below.

---

# (Optional) training module info

**Learning goals:** Multiple paragraphs and markdown format can be used.

**Prework:** Multiple paragraphs and markdown format can be used.

**Slides:** HTML link to presentation slides

**Transcript:** HTML link to transcript

**OLS training program name:** If this training module was recorded as part of an OLS training program name, provide the program name. Make sure to expand acronyms so that an outsider understands it. E.g. "Open Seeds cohort 2"

**OLS training program link:** HTML link to the training program and cohort, e.g. https://we-are-ols.org/openseeds/ols-2/

**Speaker names and usernames:** To find the speaker's username, look at the [OLS people page](https://we-are-ols.org/people.html), find their listing, and right click the link icon in the upper right corner of their speaker biography. Then paste that link here. The username is the string after the # symbol. You can also find past speaker information in [_data/openseeds/library.yaml](https://github.com/open-life-science/open-life-science.github.io/blob/main/_data/openseeds/library.yaml).

**Citation information:** How should people cite this training module video? Include both citation text, and a HTML link that should be cited. No markdown formatting is allowed.

**Resources:** Markdown formatted description and links to resources provided in the training video. E.g. [2016 article on FAIR data practices](https://www.nature.com/articles/sdata201618) - Wilkinson, M., Dumontier, M., Aalbersberg, I. et al. The FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship. Sci Data 3, 160018 (2016). [https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2016.18](https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2016.18)

## (Optional) New training topic info

If this is a new topic, please fill out the new training topic information below

**Training topic name:** E.g. Open Data

**Motivation for study:** Why would someone want to study this topic? (Not what they will study)

**(Optional) Customization:** What kinds of customization will OLS offer for this training module? E.g. how would it be tailored to different audiences?

**(Optional) Topic image:** HTML link to an icon-like image that will be used for representing the topic on the training catalogue page.

**(Optional) Topic image alt text:** Description of the topic image.
